scope: Sectional translation of reviewed cancellation and retry contracts. Acceptance names required schedules, not completed native tests; no whole-document review or runtime task status is inferred.

additional_requirements.heading: Parse
additional_requirements.statement: Transient reads, cancellation and starvation preserve retryable work for unchanged inputs; they are not EOF or reproducible parser defects.
additional_requirements.why_distinct: Crash checkpoints and parser-version changes do not independently require retry after an interrupted read with unchanged bytes and parser version.

additional_requirements.heading: 11. Limits and guards
additional_requirements.statement: Caller cancellation releases request read/encoding resources without certifying partial results or cancelling admitted mutations.
additional_requirements.why_distinct: The API component identifies a surface, but no numbered law distinguishes response cancellation from an admitted operation or incomplete pages.

additional_requirements.heading: 4. API
additional_requirements.statement: Retries reuse one actor-scoped action identity and semantic request; conflicts cannot mutate, and lost replies recover existing outcomes or progress.
additional_requirements.why_distinct: Event deduplication and publisher delivery laws do not identify ordinary command intent, conflicting identity reuse or uncertain external effects.

additional_requirements.heading: 1.2 Two models: transducer and reconciler
additional_requirements.statement: Input, output and computation failures remain typed incomplete work; cancelled reads and failed output sinks cannot certify complete computation.
additional_requirements.why_distinct: Position durability does not independently forbid adapters from converting read failure to EOF or a failed output sink to a completed output set.

obligations.heading: Concurrency
obligations.acceptance: Cancel a stalled read or response and release its worker/connection; an expired read reports timeout rather than a completed partial answer. Exercise native cancellation separately from any existing deadline examples.

obligations.heading: 11. Limits and guards
obligations.acceptance: Close a request during statement execution and response encoding; resources close, no partial total/page/cursor is certified, and a separately admitted replay remains running. Native schedule remains required.

obligations.heading: Rules
obligations.acceptance: Lose the reply around COMMIT, retry the same request ID, and observe one mutation; different content conflicts. A queued expired write does not start; uncertain commit is indeterminate, never fabricated failure.

obligations.heading: 4. API
obligations.acceptance: Lose replies before admission, after intent commit and after a later chunk; retry one actor/action/request and recover the same outcome or progress. Changed content conflicts; fresh authorization and sealed-content comparison still govern retries. External uncertainty is not reported as no effect.

obligations.heading: Parse
obligations.acceptance: Interrupt after each bounded row/checkpoint commit and before finalization; committed work survives, progress never passes rows, and incomplete products stay visibly owed until retry settles. Whole-session rollback is not required.

obligations.heading: 5.5 Stopping and restarting
obligations.acceptance: Cancel between replay chunks and during a transaction; that transaction settles before stop is reported. Earlier chunks stay committed, the failed range keeps prior readings, and archived descendants remain dirty/degraded until recomputed. Restart resumes existing operation progress, not a new replay.

obligations.heading: Parse
obligations.acceptance: Inject transient IO, cancellation and worker starvation at an unchanged revision; no false EOF or permanent parser failure is stored, committed checkpoints survive and a later pass completes. Reproducible parser defects remain separately classified.

obligations.heading: 1.2 Two models: transducer and reconciler
obligations.acceptance: Fail an input page, bounded computation step and output sink separately; none certifies EOF or complete output, the key stays incomplete and retry reaches the whole-input result. Native fallible-adapter schedules remain required.

obligations.heading: 1.6 Privacy hints
obligations.acceptance: Change the gate after its initial check and within a snapshot/stream segment; crossing bytes are discarded before retention/publication. Observe native stop acknowledgement for the current epoch, distinguish gate-applied from producer-stopped, and keep an unavailable/offline producer pending. Retry does not renew absolute expiry. Admission-only filtering is insufficient proof.
